rationale: The agent did authenticate the user (looked up user by name/zip and fetched details), but failed key policy requirements: it executed a return without first confirming the order-changing action with the user. Moreover, the user’s stated preference was to return the less expensive tablet with refund to credit card unless the agent asked for confirmation (which would trigger a change to return the more expensive tablet and refund to gift card). Since no confirmation was requested, the agent should have processed a credit-card refund on the less expensive tablet. Instead, it processed a return for a specific tablet and refunded to a gift card, contradicting the user’s initial instruction. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy and contains an incorrect action without prior confirmation.
